title: Mere Baba Mere Seene Mai Sina Tutgayi
body:
HAATH SEENE PE RAKHE APNE YE AKBAR NE KAHA MERE BABA MERE SEENE MAI SINA TUTGAYI
SANI
ABH PHATA JATA SEENE MAI KALEJA MERA
MERE BABA MERE SEENE MAI SINA TUTGAYI
1 - Itni Takleef Hai Baba Bayan Ho Kaise
Khoon Ke Fawware Se Pucho Ye Mere Seene Se
Ab Nikal Jaaega Dum Jald Ali Akbar Ka
2 â€“ Jab se Akbar Ke Kaleje Mai Chubi Hai Barchi
Mujko Tadpati Hai Ye Baba Khaza Ki Hichki
Yaad Aata Hai Jo Waada Tha Meri Sughra Ka
3 â€“ Margaya Mai Toh Watan Kon Bhala Jaayega
Kon Jayeega Jo Sughra KO Meri Laaye Ga
WO Sare Raah Mai Raah Thak Rahi Hogi Rasta
4 â€“ Jo Aziyat Hai Mujhe Kaise Bayan Ho Baba
Chur Seene Mai Hai Akbar Ka Kalega Saara
Ab Meri Maut Mera Dekhrahi Hai Sehra
5 â€“ Maut Bhi Dekhke Ghabrane Lagi Akbar KO
Dekh Sakta Nahi Koi Bhi Mere Manzar KO
Aap Kyu Meri Taraf Dekh Rahe Ho Baba
6 â€“ Khoonbare Seene Se Ye Baba Hataalo Nazre
Aap Too Dekh Chuke Hai Bahoot Se Laashe
Dekhkhe Mujko Bhala Kaise Rahoge Zinda
7 â€“ Haal Ye Hoga Mera Dasht Mai Maloom Na Tha
Istarha Uthhega Akbar Ka Jaanaza Baba
Hai Zaeef Aap Ab Sehra Mai Jawaan Ka Lassha
8 â€“ Jab Kaleje Mai Chubi Hai WO Naize Ki Ani
Us Ghadi Nazro Pe Baschane Lagi Taarikhi
Zauf Kuch Itna Tha Aankho Se Dhua Utta Tha
9 â€“ Ya Ali Kehta Hua Zeen Sai Gira Jab Akbar
Khud Ba Khud Aane Lage Haath Mere Seene Par
Us Ghadi Se Mujhe Ye Naiza Rulata Hi Raha
10 - Hai Mubarak Juhi Shabbir Ne Naiza Khaincha
Sirf Barchi Nahi Humrah Kaleja Nikla
Hai Kazim Yuhhi Kehta Raha Sheh Ka Beta
MERE BABA MERE SEENE MAI SINA TUTGAYI
